method: Built-in image_gen; no fallback API. Source PNGs preserved outside repository; runtime assets nearest-neighbor resized to 640x360 then lossless WebP.
art_direction: Warm, crisp SFC pixel-art storybook. Existing cast appearance and approved concept reference. Initial same-plane standing comparison established Sam approximately 1.2 times protagonist height with approximately equal head size. Reverse camera faces south entrance; chest left, dog beds right. Table moved during clearing, per user acceptance.
base_prompt: Production 16:9 SFC pixel-art opening. Preserve warm timber home identity, single south-center entrance seen from reverse camera, chest to left of doorway, three dog beds to right. Same-scale heads, Sam only 1.18 times protagonist standing height. Rich amber light, crisp pixel clusters, earthy palette. No text, borders or overlays.

variant_prompts.call: Protagonist seated at table left, holding open diary pages flat with both hands, looking up at Sam beside half-open door right. Preserve camera and floor path.
variant_prompts.refusal: Only protagonist pose changes: closed aged brown diary held against chest with both hands, lean back slightly, politely reluctant expression.
variant_prompts.nose: Only add small orange Shiba nose/head peeking around left edge of half-open door at floor level. Body hidden.
variant_prompts.threshold: Exactly three puppies cross same threshold toward foreground protagonist: orange Shiba blue collar, black-white collie green bandanna, black-tan Shiba purple collar.
variant_prompts.cling: Selected dog presses nose to shorts hem beside stool; remaining two stand along same doorway-to-stool floor path. Protagonist looks down warmly, holds diary at chest.
variant_prompts.boy: Replace only protagonist with navy backward cap, short dark hair, teal shirt, beige fishing vest, navy shorts, white socks and brown boots; same pose and geometry.
variant_prompts.diary: Overhead closeup aged fish diary on same table; blue cloth, white flowers, fish mug and brown cup. Bare hands cropped before sleeves, gender neutral. Sepia fish and cabin diagrams, abstract illegible writing.
variant_prompts.diary-turn: Only right leaf curls upward toward spine with underside and shadow; fixed book, hands and background.
variant_prompts.diary-settled: Next spread after leaf turns left and lies flat: fin and weed diagram left; lake, mountains and small fish research notes right. Same book geometry, hands and background. Renderer may clip only right page to keep left unchanged.

validation: Inspected all generated images. Both genders and all three selected-companion cling variants present; chosen puppy is at clothing hem, exactly three puppies in group frames. All final assets readable at 640x360.
